feedback.Physical Object: Included — A standalone, tangible device installed in physical space.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — Manufactured using plastic, metal, and electronic components.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — No biological origin or analog.
feedback.Powered: Included — Requires battery or mains power to operate sensors and alarms.
feedback.Structural: Included — Has an organized internal structure and fixed outer shell.
feedback.Observable: Included — Visibly mounted; includes indicators (LEDs, markings).
feedback.Active: Included — Continuously monitors its environment for input and triggers output.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Purpose-built for smoke detection and alerting.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Included — Emits sound and/or light in response to internal conditions.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Uses internal circuitry or software to determine alarm state.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Transitions between idle and alarm states.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Included — Includes test buttons, indicator tones, and battery alerts.
feedback.System-integrated: Included — Often part of home automation, security, or fire suppression systems.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Included — Operates independently once installed and powered.
feedback.System-Essential: Included — If removed, the fire detection system fails in its core function.
feedback.Symbolic: Excluded — Not used as a representation or cultural signifier.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Emits meaningful status information (alerts, chirps, LED signals).
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Follows programmed logic for detection and alerts.
feedback.Compositional: Excluded — Not composed of abstract modular subsystems.
feedback.Normative: Excluded — Does not express norms or expectations.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Operates over time, checking and responding to conditions.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Internal logic typically managed via ICs or firmware.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Materially and functionally defined, not symbolically.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Included — Legally required in most buildings and classified in safety codes.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not associated with social identity or roles.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Subject to strict safety and certification requirements.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Mass-produced, essential to safety and construction industries.
feedback.Politicised: Excluded — Not a focus of political discourse or controversy.
feedback.Ritualised: Excluded — Not involved in symbolic cultural practice.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Central to life safety, risk prevention, and moral responsibility.

encoding_notes: This encoding captures the smoke detector as a regulated, digitally governed safety device essential to fire protection systems. Its autonomy, structure, and ethical relevance justify a high-trait density. Final UHT code: DFFF6359.
